shots.text: The Pale Vesper fell on the steps of Vesperhold, still singing, and the dead she had raised lay down around her.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Pale Vesper falling on the floating steps, her ghost-choir scattering like moths, the dead dropping where they stand.

shots.text: In the crypt under her steps, among the dead she had not yet woken, lay my half-brother, Corvin. Six years ago he was found over a dead man, and I exiled him for murder. He had lived on the edge of the Rift ever since, watching the Gate.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A Veilwalker crypt. Corvin the Uncrowned cutting himself free of grave-wrappings with a black glass blade, hood back, silver hair, a scar through his eyebrow.

shots.text:
Six years I told them it was the Marshal. Now they believe me.

The man I was exiled for killing saw Cassivane cut a piece off the Heartstone. That's why he died.
shots.speaker: corvin
shots.art_note: Corvin standing, looking at the player. Joins as a hero.
